image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, clinging to a vertical tree trunk or rock surface. The salamander displays the characteristic glossy black skin with vivid yellow irregular spots and bands. Its body is robust and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The head is broad and flattened, and the tail is laterally compressed. The background consists of a textured, mossy surface with some fallen leaves and debris at the bottom.
